## Risks

**Memory blow-up on large exports.** Streaming a million-row export through an in-memory buffer will OOM the worker. Mitigation: pipe rows through a chunked encoder; budget peak heap to 64 MB regardless of export size.

**Locale-specific number formatting.** European customers expect `;` as the delimiter and `,` as the decimal separator. Defaulting to US-style breaks their downstream pipelines. Mitigation: surface a `--locale` flag and default to the workspace's configured locale.

**PII leakage via filenames.** The default filename embeds the report title verbatim, which has already leaked customer names in support tickets. Mitigation: hash the title fragment in non-interactive flows and require an explicit `--filename` to keep the human-readable form.

rationale: Existing Risks section only listed the memory case. Two production incidents this quarter exposed the locale and filename gaps; folding them in.
